name: Xixi

queries.query: Xixi China Jieyang cadastral map parcel official GIS
queries.result: Discovery found Guangdong's official Tianditu public map service and the national geographic-information catalog, but no first-party Xixi/Jieyang cadastral parcel viewer or open parcel endpoint was identified.

queries.query: 揭阳 西溪 地籍图 宗地 官方 自然资源
queries.result: Chinese-language discovery identified the official Guangdong Tianditu portal and Guangdong Natural Resources Department as the map publisher, but did not identify a public Xixi/Jieyang parcel registry or parcel geometry API.

officialSources.publisher: Guangdong Natural Resources Department / Guangdong Map Institute
officialSources.observation: Official Guangdong public map portal; current HTML and JavaScript were retrieved anonymously over TLS. The visible/configured public service is a general map platform, not an evidenced cadastral registry for Xixi.
Provincial natural-resources authority link used by the official map portal; no city-specific public parcel service was evidenced in this attempt.

officialSources.publisher: National Geomatics Center of China / Ministry of Natural Resources ecosystem
officialSources.observation: Official national geographic-information resource catalog landing page; general catalog evidence only, not a verified Xixi parcel source.

requestOutcomes.outcome: TLS-verified live portal HTML retrieved. It referenced current JavaScript/configuration files.
Current configuration exposed the Guangdong map service URL, village-map path, and public map settings; no cadastral layer or parcel schema was exposed.
Current JavaScript retrieved and inspected for cadastral/parcel routes; observed public vector-tile/base-map references and portal service routes, but no safe parcel ID-plus-geometry response.
Endpoint returned ArcGIS-style JSON error code 499, Token Required. No token was requested, inferred, or bypassed; no schema or geometry was retained.
Official national catalog landing page retrieved; no bounded Xixi parcel request was available from the public landing response.

parcelDiscovery.source: No qualified city/local cadastral source; Guangdong Tianditu public map portal inspected as a first-party lead

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Guangdong provincial public map portal and national geographic-information catalog landing page.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: General public map configuration was verified, but no open Xixi/Jieyang parcel layer, schema, or geometry was verified.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only if source-proven
uncertainty: The public hosted vector-tile endpoint required a token; no authentication or token circumvention was attempted.
The map portal's general administrative/base layers do not establish cadastral availability or citywide parcel coverage.
The exact WUP point was preserved and was not shifted or used as an absence test.
No local Xixi/Jieyang registry custodian with public parcel geometry was evidenced in this attempt.
doNotInfer: A token-required endpoint, lack of a visible cadastral layer, or no exact-point hit is not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
General provincial/national map catalog pages are not a city cadastral registry.
Packet completion is not source integration or admission.
